'''Nick Kolnik''' (forum handle '''bluethrawn''') served as an advocate of the [[Players Committee]] for marketing and tournaments.

He accepted an invitation to become the Marketing &amp; Tournaments Player Advocate in 2004. His responsibilities were promoting tournaments and communicating event information to the playing community, working directly with the Tournaments Advocate.<ref name="newadv2004">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040603214022/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/NewAdvocates.htm New Advocates! Not 1 but 2!], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 June 2004)</ref> He had played since February 1996, had directed tournaments since the spring of 1999, and coordinated players in the Twin Cities.<ref name="newadv2004" /> In October 2004 [[Michael Carr]] wrote that he would work with Kolnik on Worlds 2005 and its qualifying season.<ref name="carr">[https://web.archive.org/web/20041013013300/http://swccgpc.com:80/News/MikeBio.htm Meet Michael Carr, New Tournaments Advocate!], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 13 October 2004)</ref> For the Road to Worlds 2005, tournament directors sent applications to run State and Provincial Championships, Opens and Mini-Opens to Kolnik, Carr or their local Flight Leader.<ref name="pc-rtw05">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/2005worlds.htm The Road to Worlds 2005], swccgpc.com (2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041216041033/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/2005worlds.htm Internet Archive]</ref> In late 2004 completed prize package order forms also went to Carr or Kolnik.<ref name="pc-prize04">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Prize_Structure_2004.htm Prizes, Prizes, and More Prizes!], swccgpc.com (2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041216042725/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Prize_Structure_2004.htm Internet Archive]</ref> In October 2008 [[Scott Lingrell]] credited Evan and Kolnik with improving the PC forums.<ref name="pc-lingrell08">[http://www.swccgpc.com/news/news.php?id=7 10 Questions with Scott Lingrell], swccgpc.com (8 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081009225918/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/news.php?id=7 Internet Archive]</ref>

In April 2003 Kolnik told players in the United Kingdom that the [[Players Committee]] could only support events there if local community leaders organized them: "Be a leader, or find one."<ref name="pcf-1309-23994">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23994#23994 Desperately seeking Endor!], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (14 April 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041118162225/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23970%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In May 2003 he directed players who wanted decks reviewed to the Players Committee's partner sites [[DeckTech]] and [[Game Players Network]].<ref name="pcf-1448-25382">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=25382#25382 following on from what GO was saying...], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (9 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041120152757/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=25407%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> On 6 May 2003 he ordered glass trophies bearing the Players Committee logo for the top four players of both the [[2003 Minnesota State Championship]] and the [[2003 Wisconsin State Championship]].<ref name="pcf-1291-25251">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=25251#25251 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (7 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Before the Minnesota championship, a "Road to States" series of constructed tournaments ran at Twin City Comics, beginning on 25 May 2003; Kolnik reported the events on the forum and posted pictures on the series website.<ref name="pcf-1291-27254">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=27254#27254 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (26 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> He won the 8 June 2003 Road to States tournament as the only undefeated player of 14.<ref name="pcf-1291-28951">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=28951#28951 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (9 June 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In September 2003, when players discussed who should succeed [[Andrew Howard]] as [[Tournament Advocate]], [[Greg Zinn]] wrote that Kolnik was "essentially perfect for the job", running "the biggest tournaments year-round" and helping at DragonCon.<ref name="pcf-2188-33233">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=33233#33233 New Tournament Advocate], Greg Zinn (Gergall), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (17 September 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040112231657/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=36534%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> [[Peter Jacobson]] backed him too, calling Minnesota, the region Kolnik supported, "the hotest place for SWCCG on the planet".<ref name="pcf-2188-33409">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=33409#33409 New Tournament Advocate], Peter Jacobson (Jeeps), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (19 September 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040112231657/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=36534%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In December 2003 he pointed players in Iowa to the MNSWCCG Yahoo! Group mailing list, which a number of Iowa players already subscribed to;<ref name="pcf-2228-38175">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=38175#38175 Anybody interested in Iowa tournaments??], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 December 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040309014127/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39671%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> in September 2004 he described the group as the communication tool for all players in the Bespin Region, including Missouri.<ref name="pcf-4010-54670">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54670#54670 Starwars CCG in St. Louie], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (28 September 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041101053307/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4010%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In August 2004 he wrote that Yahoo! Groups were used to coordinate many SWCCG playing communities.<ref name="pcf-3805-52666">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52666#52666 CardTablers], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (15 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041227104522/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52017%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

In April 2004 he told players that they were "grossly overestimating" the inventory the Players Committee had left.<ref name="pcf-3078-44112">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=44112#44112 Is this game dead??], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (5 April 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040427135016/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=44074%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> That month [[Garrett Larson]] praised the prize support Kolnik had put together for state-level tournaments: "glass for top 4 and cash prizes for top 3".<ref name="pcf-3180-44992">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=44992#44992 SWCCG worlds and more], Garrett Larson (deadbody), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (18 April 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040709185410/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=45251%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> On 27 May 2004, newly brought on as an Advocate, he wrote that he had ordered two Ultimate and two Premiere prize packages from the Players Committee's new prize support program for the four state championships he was running that season, and that he would promote the Minnesota and Wisconsin championships with the virtual card design opportunity attached.<ref name="pcf-3360-46831">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46831#46831 New Prize Support Packages], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (27 May 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625212826/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47063%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> He directed the 2004 North Dakota State Championship in Fargo on 12 June 2004,<ref name="pcf-3385-47002">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47002#47002 2004 North Dakota SWCCG State Championship], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (1 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041031011758/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47002%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> the 2004 Minnesota State Championship Weekend at Twin City Comics on 18–19 June 2004<ref name="pcf-3386-47003">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47003#47003 2004 Minnesota SWCCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (1 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021754/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47421%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> and the 2004 Wisconsin State Championship at Misty Mountain Games in Madison on 10 July 2004.<ref name="pcf-3387-47004">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47004#47004 2004 Wisconsin SWCCG State Championship], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (1 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021916/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=50355%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> On 24 June 2004 he wrote that the Twin Cities tournaments would move away from a weekly format by the end of the summer and that he planned to support them with Players Committee prize packages.<ref name="pcf-3360-48043">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48043#48043 New Prize Support Packages], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625212826/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47063%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> His forum signature in 2004 read "Marketing & Tournaments Advocate, Bespin Region Flight Leader, Squadron Member Shadow 63" ([[Shadow Squadron]]).<ref name="pcf-3617-49462">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=49462#49462 SWCCG Rating system?], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (12 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040908230638/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3617%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> On 1 August 2004 he was compiling, in his official capacity, the list of [[2004 World Championship]] Day 2 qualifiers from e-mails by the directors of 2004 championship circuit events; he accepted qualifier information only from an event's director ("anything less is hearsay").<ref name="pcf-3789-51795">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51795#51795 Can someone post a list of those who qualified for day 2?], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (1 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040908230643/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3789%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> On 20 September 2004, asked whether an October regional was too early for the 2005 season, he answered that it was not and that State Championships would still be held.<ref name="pcf-3974-54298">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54298#54298 From Rebels to Mavericks: 2005 Endor Regional Weekend], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 September 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226184856/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54272%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In October 2004 [[David Kangas]] wrote that Kolnik was a member of the Advocate Council, the Flight Leader program, Shadow Squadron and a couple of other sub-committees, and oversaw tournament operations for the entire Bespin region.<ref name="pcf-4063-55368">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55368#55368 State of the PC Address: So long and thanks for all the fish], David Kangas (Shadow 31), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050228234323/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55374%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

The 2005 and 2006 council pages list him in St. Paul, Minnesota, as Marketing and Tournaments Advocate. That council page says he worked on marketing ideas, assisted the tournament advocate, and watched the discussion forum.<ref name="council2005">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050829220138/http://www.swccgpc.com/council.htm Advocate Council], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 29 August 2005)</ref><ref name="advocates2006">[https://web.archive.org/web/20060617221233/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Content&pa=showpage&pid=3 Advocates], swccgpc.com Content pid=3 (published 1 May 2006; Wayback, 17 June 2006)</ref>

Kolnik donated his entire collection to a school-run Star Wars CCG program. The starwarsccg.org About Us page calls him &ldquo;a former Advocate and devoted Star Wars CCG player&rdquo; (spelled &ldquo;Nick Kolnick&rdquo;).<ref name="aboutlive">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/about-us/ About Us], starwarsccg.org (viewed 10 October 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020234816/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/about-us.html Internet Archive].</ref>

== Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 1 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]] name Nick Kolnik (1 original concept credit).<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited card is in [[Virtual Block 4]], dated 2009 on this wiki. The concept credit also names the event or award the concept came from: PC Volunteer Award 2006 (1 card). The full list of everyone credited is at [[Card Credits#Nick Kolnik|Card Credits]].
